_about: Facts the Windows copy quotes. null means nobody has decided or proven it yet; the launch script refuses to publish while any fact it needs is null. Fill these from the win-core and win-release reports, never from a guess.

hotkey.what: Name of the default hold-to-talk key on Windows, as printed on the keyboard (for example "Right Alt").
hotkey.source: Parity row C1: needs Pubba's decision. Alt alone opens menus and the Windows key opens Start.

minOS.source: Windows team goal (win-core brief). Confirm before launch: say Windows 10 only if it has been run there.

arch.what: Processor type the installer is built for.
arch.source: Windows team goal; installer name in win-release report.

installer.source: win-release report: file name contract (parity row A1).

wingetId.source: Parity row A5: manifest prepared, not submitted. Only used where the 'winget' claim is proven.

dataDir.what: Where settings, models and recordings live.

signed.what: Is the installer code-signed (so Windows opens it without the 'Windows protected your PC' screen)?
signed.source: win-release: no certificate exists (parity row A3). Set true only once a signed installer has been run on Windows.

version.what: First Cadence version with a Windows build, for example "1.0.0".
